title: The yard moves: a skippable once-per-session boot, a streak on the trial row, and every animation still under reduced motion
description: A real browser on the built dashboard: the one-second boot sequence (neon logo flicker-in, readout typing out) plays once per browser session and any key skips it; a row whose merge trial is out carries a running light streak; the rain falls in two parallax sheets with rain and grain behind all page content, headings flicker in and the top line types itself out; with prefers-reduced-motion every animation is still and no boot runs.

steps.name: boot, streak and the motion gates on the dashboard
